source_license: CC0-1.0; existing official source archive and license retained
requirements: Keep authoritative hp, shooting, collision, round and spectator rules unchanged
Retarget using uncalibrated source/target rest frames; never treat calibrated rifle pose as the retarget bind pose
Blend from actual death-entry pose without accumulating transforms; preserve bone lengths, topology and materials
Retain the right-hand weapon relation only until release; preserve the release transform in death-entry actor coordinates and restore the exact original mount on seek/reset

Offline weapon simulation uses the licensed rifle geometry as convex-hull input, inherited centre-of-mass/angular velocity, metre units and a flat floor at actor-local y=0; this is not a general map-wall collision solution
Pin source motion, character, rifle, calibration, ground bake, hull input and physics dependency hashes; runtime playback must not import the offline physics engine
Check rendered weapon vertices at physics steps and interpolated poses; measure dynamic body crossings and do not accept floor-only physics when the weapon passes through the body
Validate continuous full 2.4-second motion, body and rifle ground penetration, final settlement, clothing deformation, walls and round reset
No runtime integration before visual/contact acceptance; six existing actors maximum and bounded data/cost

probes.ground_lift: candidate/ground-lift-v2.json; 107 adaptive keys; sampled body floor pass at 961 poses, full animation acceptance pending
probes.held_weapon: qa/held-contact-v2/report.json; inherited stock contact and increased torso crossings at 0.1s; do not use a late 0.1s release
